# .github

This directory indexes GitHub-facing collaboration and governance files for
`swift-codex`.

## Belongs Here

- pull request templates
- issue templates
- issue-template configuration
- GitHub Actions workflows
- other GitHub-specific collaboration configuration

## Does Not Belong Here

- product architecture and usage documentation
- task-specific plans and investigation notes
- long-form contributor guidance better kept in root governance files

## Current Files

- `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug.md`
- `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature.md`
- `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/_config.yml`
- `pull_request_template.md`
- `dependabot.yml`
- `workflows/api-breaking-changes.yml`
- `workflows/commit-message.yml`
- `workflows/real-codex-binary.yml`
- `workflows/release-gate.yml`
- `workflows/swift-package.yml`
- `signing-allowed-signers`: release tag signature verification key

## Related Files

- `../CODEOWNERS`: default ownership
- `../CONTRIBUTING.md`: repo-wide contributor guidance
- `../SECURITY.md` and `../SUPPORT.md`: reporting guidance
- `../Documentation/README.md`: public documentation index
